'''Alto''' was the [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nallastia]]'s [[Raptor Clan]]. He lived a double life as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named '''Rench''' at [[Fondor Spaceport]]. Princess [[Calvaria]], the daughter of Nallastia's [[Skull Queen]], was [[Marriage/Legends|betrothed]] to Alto, although she did not love him. She secretly loved Rench. Following [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|takeover]] of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Calvaria realized to her delight that Alto and Rench were one and the same.
